source_scope: fr1/desk_lightswitch direct Conv1/Layer2 greedy searches and completed Step-P C2F grid

selection.source_metric: historical keyframe evo_ape ATE mean with --align --correct_scale
selection.selection_rule: Show the gray control; all direct parents needed to interpret each C2F cell; the global C2F best; a strong positive synergy; and high-ranked direct-parent cases where C2F is worse.

candidates.label: gray_baseline
candidates.role: Photometric grayscale baseline; no learned tracking features.

candidates.label: resnet_layer2_direct_c4_d67_d108_d121
candidates.role: Direct coarse parent C4, selected because it is the coarse component of the global C2F optimum.

candidates.label: resnet_layer2_direct_c5_d108_d121
candidates.role: Direct coarse parent C5, selected because it produces the strongest C2F synergy with F6.

candidates.label: resnet_conv1_direct_f1_d15_d20_d26_d34
candidates.role: Direct fine parent F1: global direct Conv1 optimum on fr1/desk_lightswitch.

candidates.label: resnet_conv1_direct_f2_d23_d24_d26_d51_d63

candidates.label: resnet_conv1_direct_f6_d29_d33_d52
candidates.role: Direct fine parent F6, included because it has the largest observed C2F gain with C5.

candidates.label: resnet_c2f_b_f2_c4_global_best
